property_summary: For any call to transfer(from, caddress, tos, v) where a single recipient's transferFrom reverts, the reference C must revert the entire transfer call (propagating the failure because it requires the external call to succeed), whereas the buggy M ignores the failed call and returns true; this is observed by deploying a minimal reverting callee and asserting that c.transfer reverts (via a try/catch success flag) when transferFrom fails.
change_summary: Remove the require on the external call success flag, so a failed transferFrom call no longer causes transfer to revert.
